name: Deep Learning 7 — Practice Lab (Regression, MNIST and Autoencoder Anomaly Detection)
description: Guided learner workspace for the seventh lab of a Deep Learning course (1.0 edition, run in Google Colab), with three tasks: housing-price regression on a real target, MNIST digit recognition with a one-hot target, and an autoencoder trained input=target for reconstruction-based anomaly detection. The Inno Agent side is a conversational tutor: the learner edits and runs the cells of PTE_DL7_EXERCISES.ipynb in Google Colab (E01, R01–R10, M01–M10, A01–A10, Z01), one cell at a time, sending back the requested short output. For ready-made cells the work is understanding and interpreting the result; in the fifteen designated cells (R04–R06, R10, M03–M06, M09, A03–A05, A07–A09) the learner writes short code of their own, and the tutor helps step by step instead of handing over the full solution. Named checkpoints: the R03 split (303/101/102), the M09 test set, and the A08 threshold fixed at the 97th percentile of the normal calibration errors before the test, with no tuning on the test set afterwards. The lab closes with three oral questions; no homework. Internet access and a personal Colab session are required, GPU is optional.
